auth.sessionMissingAfterLogin: Logged in, but no session was returned. Try again.

loginErrors.accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for now.
loginErrors.invalidCredentials: That display name and password didn't match.
loginErrors.legacyAccount: This account was created before the data-key format and can't be opened.
loginErrors.rolledBack: Nothing was changed. Your old password still works.
loginErrors.resumeFailed: The unfinished change couldn't be completed right now, and nothing is lost. Try again, use your recovery phrase, or restart QuietRabbit if it keeps failing.

restore.heading: Restore access with your recovery phrase
restore.intro: Enter your 24-word recovery phrase and choose a new password. Your data is re-locked under a new key and the new password, so the old password stops opening it from then on. This can take a while for a large account. Copies or backups made before the change can still be opened with your old password. Your recovery phrase stays the same.
restore.mismatch: The new password and its confirmation don't match.

interrupted.heading: A change to this account was interrupted
interrupted.intro: A password change for {{name}} was interrupted before it finished, and the password you typed is the old one. Your data is safe. To finish the change, sign in with the NEW password, or use your recovery phrase. Or cancel the change and keep using your old password.
interrupted.signInNew: Sign in with the new password
interrupted.cancelIntro: Cancelling puts everything back as it was, and you then sign in with your old password. To prove it's you, enter the new password or your recovery phrase. A change that has already been completed can't be cancelled; finish it instead.
interrupted.cancelled: The change was cancelled. Nothing was changed. Sign in with your old password.

recoveryPhrase.heading: Recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.intro: Your 24-word recovery phrase opens your data if you forget your password. If someone else may have seen it, create a new one: the old words then stop opening your current data.

changePassword.heading: Change password
changePassword.intro: Changing your password re-locks all of your data under a new key, so the old password stops opening it from then on. This can take a while for a large account. Copies or backups made before the change can still be opened with your old password, and nothing can change that.
changePassword.mismatch: The new password and its confirmation don't match.
changePassword.success: Your password was changed. Your data is protected under the new password from now on. Copies or backups made before the change can still be opened with your old password.

newPhrase.intro: A new recovery phrase replaces your current one. You will be shown 24 new words once, asked to re-enter a few of them, and then your data is re-locked under a new key. After that the old words no longer open your current data. Nothing changes until you confirm the new words, and until then your old phrase keeps working. Copies or backups made before the change can still be opened with your old password and your old words, and nothing can change that.
newPhrase.confirmSubmit: Confirm and replace my recovery phrase
newPhrase.success: Your new recovery phrase is active. The old words no longer open your current data. Keep the new words safe and offline. Copies or backups made before this change can still be opened with your old password and your old words.

recoveryPhrase.showIntro: Write these 24 words down in order and keep them somewhere safe and offline. They are shown only once.
recoveryPhrase.showWarning: Anyone who has these words can unlock your data, and QuietRabbit cannot show them again. There is no copy button on purpose.
recoveryPhrase.confirmIntro: The words are hidden now. To check that you have them, enter the words at these positions.

phase.rekeying: Re-locking your data under the new key

rotation.keepOpen: This can take a while for a large account. Please keep QuietRabbit open until it finishes.
rotation.crashSafe: If QuietRabbit closes or stops part-way, nothing is lost. The change finishes the next time you sign in: use the password you just set, or your recovery phrase.

outcome.complete: The change is finished. Your data is protected under the new key from now on. Copies or backups made before the change can still be opened with the credentials you used before it.
outcome.rolledBack: Nothing was changed. Your old password still works.
outcome.failed: The change did not finish, and nothing is lost. It will finish the next time you sign in: use the password you just set, or your recovery phrase.

rotationErrors.notLoggedIn: You're not signed in. Sign in again to continue.
rotationErrors.invalidCredentials: That didn't match. Check it and try again.
rotationErrors.accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for now.
rotationErrors.phraseInvalid: That isn't a valid 24-word recovery phrase. Check the words and try again.
rotationErrors.rotationInProgress: A password or recovery change is already running or waiting to finish. Let it finish, then try again.
rotationErrors.activeRuns_one: {{count}} task is still running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it, then try again. Nothing was changed.
rotationErrors.activeRuns_other: {{count}} tasks are still running. Wait for them to finish or cancel them, then try again. Nothing was changed.
rotationErrors.busy: QuietRabbit is busy with something else right now, for example a chat reply that is still being written. Wait for it to finish, then try again. Nothing was changed.
rotationErrors.insufficientSpace: There isn't enough free disk space. This change needs about {{needed}} MB free and {{available}} MB is available. Free up some space and try again. Nothing was changed.
rotationErrors.freeSpaceUnknown: QuietRabbit couldn't check how much disk space is free, so the change didn't start. Nothing was changed.
rotationErrors.unrecognisedFiles: Your account's data folder contains files QuietRabbit doesn't recognise, so the change didn't start. Nothing was changed. If you added files there yourself, move them elsewhere and try again.
rotationErrors.databaseUnreadable: Part of your data couldn't be opened, so the change didn't start. Nothing was changed.
rotationErrors.epochChanged: Your account was changed from another window or session. Sign in again to continue.
rotationErrors.rotationAlreadyComplete: That change had already finished, so it can't be cancelled. Sign in with the new password or your recovery phrase to complete it.
rotationErrors.rolledBack: Nothing was changed. Your old password still works.
rotationErrors.needsResume: The change didn't finish, and nothing is lost. It will finish the next time you sign in with the password you just set, or with your recovery phrase.
rotationErrors.noPendingPhrase: That recovery phrase is no longer waiting to be confirmed. Start again to get a new one.
rotationErrors.confirmationFailed: Those words don't match your new recovery phrase. Check the word numbers and try again. After several wrong tries the phrase is discarded and you start again.
rotationErrors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening, restart QuietRabbit.
rotationErrors.rolledBackNewPhrase: Nothing was changed. Your old password and recovery phrase still work.
rotationErrors.needsResumeNewPhrase: The change didn't finish, and nothing is lost. It will finish the next time you sign in with your password or your new recovery phrase. Keep the new phrase safe: the old one may stop working.
rotationErrors.restoreInvalidCredentials: Those words don't match this account. Check the display name and the words, then try again.
rotationErrors.rolledBackRestore: Nothing was changed. Your recovery phrase still works.
rotationErrors.needsResumeRestore: Your access wasn't fully restored, and nothing is lost. It will finish the next time you sign in with the password you just set, or with your recovery phrase.
rotationErrors.cancelInvalidCredentials: That isn't the new password or the recovery phrase for the pending change.
